name: FFmpeg Smart Profiles
description: Installs FFmpeg Smart stream/output profiles and manages hardware capacity cache rebuilds.
author: matrix2669

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: allow 10-bit
fields.help_text: Unchecked leaves 10-bit on the wrapper's automatic hardware policy.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: allow HDR
fields.help_text: Force SDR overrides this setting when both are checked.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: force SDR
fields.help_text: Takes precedence over Allow HDR.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1 options
fields.help_text: Optional ffmpeg-smart flags, for example: -vc h264 -maxres 1080 -maxbr 8M -maxchan 2

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: input defaults
fields.help_text: Inherit currently uses: -fflags +genpts+igndts+discardcorrupt -err_detect ignore_err. These run before -i. Replace removes only this managed group; URL, user-agent, reconnect, and hardware setup remain Smart-owned.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: input options
fields.help_text: For example: -fflags +discardcorrupt+genpts+nobuffer. Text with Inherit selected is treated as Add.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: stream mapping

options.label: First video and optional first audio

fields.help_text: Inherit currently uses: -map 0:v:0 -map 0:a:0? (first video and optional first audio). Smart requires exactly one mapped video per job; Map all is valid only when the input contains one video.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: custom stream mappings
fields.help_text: Use typed mappings such as -map 0:v:0 -map 0:a:0?. Replace must select exactly one video; Add already inherits its one video. Use Map all input streams instead of entering -map 0 here.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: video tuning defaults
fields.help_text: Inherit is calculated only when video transcodes: -b:v <target> -maxrate <rate> -bufsize <buffer> -g <rounded source fps> -bf <0 or 2> <accelerator tuning> -fps_mode cfr -r <source fps> [-tag:v hvc1]. Target is 8 Mbps at 1080p scaled by output pixels with a 2 Mbps floor; without -maxbr, maxrate is 125% and buffer 200% of target. With -maxbr, target is capped at 85%, maxrate equals the limit, and buffer is 2x the limit. Replace keeps Smart's encoder, filters, color policy, and explicit -maxbr ceiling.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: video tuning options
fields.help_text: For example: -g 60 -keyint_min 60 -sc_threshold 0 -force_key_frames 'expr:gte(t,n_forced*2)'.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: audio defaults
fields.help_text: Inherit is calculated per stream: no audio adds no options; compatible AAC uses -c:a copy; otherwise Smart uses -c:a aac -b:a <rate> -ac <channels> [-ch_layout ...] -af aresample=async=1. Rates are 96k mono, 192k stereo, 384k 5.1, 512k 7.1, or 64k/channel otherwise. An explicit -maxchan ceiling still follows Add or Replace.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: audio options
fields.help_text: For example: -c:a ac3 or -c:a aac -b:a 256k.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: MPEG-TS/output defaults
fields.help_text: Inherit currently uses: -avoid_negative_ts make_zero -start_at_zero -mpegts_copyts 0 -mpegts_flags +pat_pmt_at_frames+resend_headers -flush_packets 1 -max_muxing_queue_size 4096. Smart always appends -f mpegts pipe:1 after this group.

fields.label: Stream Profile 1: MPEG-TS/output options
fields.help_text: For example: -mpegts_flags +pat_pmt_at_frames+resend_headers+initial_discontinuity -muxdelay 0. Existing beta.3 values continue here.

fields.label: Remove disabled or renamed managed profiles
Update existing managed profiles
fields.help_text: Only profiles already pointing to an FFmpeg Smart managed script or matching this plugin's native FFmpeg templates are updated.

fields.label: Other flags: video and limits
fields.description: -vc h264|hevc selects output codec; -maxres 720 limits vertical resolution; -maxbr 2M limits video bitrate; -maxchan 2 limits audio channels.

fields.label: Other flags: hardware selection
fields.description: -accel qsv|vaapi|software overrides acceleration; -device, -dri-device, -qsv-device, or -vaapi-device /dev/dri/renderD128 selects a specific device.

fields.label: Managed policy flags
fields.description: The controls above generate -10bit, -hdr, -sdr, and -deint. Force SDR overrides Allow HDR. If a policy flag is entered in Additional options, Install / Update moves it to the matching checkbox and removes the duplicate.

fields.label: Input and maintenance flags
fields.description: -i and -user_agent are added by the plugin. Use Rebuild Hardware Cache instead of putting --recache or --recache-only in a profile.

fields.label: Advanced FFmpeg Smart options
fields.description: Each profile can inherit, add to, or replace scoped input, video-tuning, audio, and MPEG-TS defaults, plus select default, all-stream, or custom mapping. FFmpeg Smart keeps ownership of the hardware encoder, hardware filters, input, and final MPEG-TS pipe.

fields.label: Profile behavior
fields.description: All managed profiles use the bundled FFmpeg Smart launcher and persistent state in /data/ffmpeg_smart_profiles. When a required hardware scan is pending or active, profiles use basic FFmpeg stream copy and bypass Smart policy and hardware acceleration until Rebuild Hardware Cache succeeds.

actions.label: Install or Update Profiles
actions.description: Create the selected Stream Profile and Output Profiles.

confirm.title: Install or update profiles?
confirm.message: Adding a new profile requires a full Dispatcharr restart before it can be used. Updates to existing profiles work without a restart. Continue?

actions.label: Rebuild Hardware Cache
actions.description: Run FFmpeg Smart hardware capability and real-concurrency benchmarks in the background.

confirm.title: Rebuild hardware cache?
confirm.message: This stops active FFmpeg Smart transcodes, routes new managed starts through basic FFmpeg stream copy until the benchmark finishes, and places a heavy concurrent load on every visible GPU. Proxy-only streams continue running. Runtime is approximately 1–2 minutes for one GPU and 2–4 minutes per GPU when multiple GPUs are detected; the enabled plugin shows a detected-GPU estimate.

actions.label: Benchmark Status
actions.description: Show active benchmark progress, cached hardware capabilities, device speeds/capacities, and recent log output.

actions.label: Remove Managed Profiles
actions.description: Remove only unlocked profiles matching this plugin's managed definitions.

confirm.title: Remove managed profiles?
confirm.message: Removing profiles requires a full Dispatcharr restart before the change fully takes effect. Channels using these profiles may need to be reassigned first. Continue?
